include.description: Globs (relative to the root) of sources to mutate.

since.description: Git ref: only run mutants inside `git diff <since>`.

includeTestChanges.description: With since, also select mutants covered or imported by changed tests.

sharedCache.description: Store snapshots in the Git common directory for reuse across worktrees; separate scopes and environments.

scope.description: Diff granularity: changed nodes, or whole enclosing functions.

maxWorkers.description: Maximum active test workers across all sessions, including the dry run.

shard.description: CI partition of mutant keys as one-based INDEX/COUNT, e.g. 1/4. Separate snapshots and default report directories per shard.

runner.description: Test runner; auto picks Vitest, Jest or Bun. Playwright browser mutation runs can be slow and require explicit opt-in.

vitestConfig.description: Vitest config file, relative to the root.

jestConfig.description: Jest config file, relative to the root (experimental, native ESM only).

bunConfig.description: bunfig.toml for Bun's test runner, relative to the root (experimental).

playwrightConfig.description: Playwright config file, relative to the root; explicitly selects the slower browser mutation runner (experimental: Vite dev server required).

playwrightSourceCoverage.description: Experimental Chromium-only V8 coverage in dry runs, remapped through inline source maps to original source scopes. Adds CPU and memory overhead; default false.

arid.description: Arid (logging-only) code suppression: false runs those mutants too; callees replaces the logging call patterns.

experimentalCallgraph.description: Re-run only survivors connected to changed code in the static call graph.

fullDryRun.description: Collect coverage from every test file.

reportDir.description: Where json/html reports go, relative to the root.

high.description: Score at or above which the result is high (default 80).

low.description: Score at or above which the result is low; below is danger (default 60).

break.description: Exit 2 when the score is below this (default null: never).

weakMutation.description: Decide covered mutants that no test reaches with a different value as Survived without running them (default true).

minimalRelational.description: Mutate relational operators with the subsumption-minimal set (< -> <=, !=, false) and skip replacements a .length / indexOf lower bound proves equivalent (default false).

skipSubsumed.description: Skip coarse mutants (statement, block, literal and body removals) that have a finer mutant inside them (default false).

plugins.description: Plugin modules (relative paths or package names) providing custom mutators.

excludedMutators.description: Mutators to skip, built-in or custom, by name.

mutantsPerLine.description: Run at most this many mutants per source line, most productive mutators first (default: unlimited).

timeBudget.description: Seconds from the start of the run (dry run included) after which no further mutant is type-checked and no new mutant run starts; the rest stay pending (default: unlimited).

critical.description: Globs (relative to the root) of critical sources: any undetected mutant there that is not accepted fails the run (exit 2), whatever the thresholds.

killMatrix.description: Run every covering test for every mutant (no early exit) and report tests that kill no mutant or whose kills another test subsumes. Slower: meant for occasional runs.
